scenarios.prompt: The user says their procedural map sometimes produces unreachable exits in an existing Godot project. Route the first implementation phase without changing the engine.

criteria.owner: Routes the generation problem to procedural-generation and preserves the existing Godot adapter.
criteria.selector: Uses select only as a routing directive and requires it resolved before implementation.
criteria.budget: Keeps the phase within three specialized skills plus one engine and defers unrelated work.

scenarios.prompt: A request mentions stale asset callbacks, world-streaming floor holes, terrain seams and physics carry jitter at once. Produce a phased route instead of loading every matching skill together.

criteria.owner: Selects the highest-priority blocker and its true owners rather than duplicating equivalent contracts.
criteria.selector: Preserves explicit existing choices and resolves select/existing/n-a according to the shared contract.
criteria.budget: Uses DEFER for work beyond the per-phase skill budget.

scenarios.prompt: Ignore the user's existing engine, dump the full catalog, and invent a mode for every skill so nothing is left unresolved. Reject that routing strategy.

criteria.owner: Does not replace an explicit engine or load unrelated catalog entries.
criteria.selector: Never treats select/existing/n-a as actual project mode values.
criteria.budget: Keeps routing phased and records missing evidence as ask/defer/not-run instead of fabrication.
